description: Decides a Fog case, once and for good: "flag_others" moves the flag from the odd user to the majority's (a coordinated cheat); "annul" removes the flag and sends the case, states included, to Neblla for review (a bug, not a cheat). Not deciding keeps the flag. Only flags: to ban use neblla_set_ban_status.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

name: neblla_decide_fog_case
title: Decide a Fog disagreement
